# TypeScript Instructions

Use `.github/skills/web-frontend-development/SKILL.md` for browser/frontend TypeScript. Use `.github/skills/node-development/SKILL.md` when the owning package is a Node.js runtime, backend, CLI, service, or library scope.

This file routes TypeScript context only. Load TypeScript guidance only when definitive TypeScript evidence exists in the owning scope. Do not infer frontend or Node.js runtime ownership from `.ts`/`.tsx` extensions alone; use manifest, dependency, workspace, configuration, or script evidence.
